digest.component_or_area: plan review sizing and model escalation
propositions: Pass-1 context limit escalation silently replaces provider-qualified models with bare Anthropic ids when no class table is configured, bypassing the model-class vocabulary contract
The rung target decision in _rung_target derives both comparison sides from the ladder constant without considering the run's actual model, causing provider qualifier loss
Bedrock-qualified primaries escalate to bare Anthropic ids that compose invalid Bedrock model ids when cfg.model_provider is left untouched by replace
The defect affects the common one-criterion retry path (entry rung) not just rare deep-escalation cases, as frontier resolves to anthropic:claude-opus-4-8

_rung_target must receive the primary model as input and apply provider-agreement logic: agree/undeterminable providers return today's value, differing providers on primary's own rung return primary verbatim, differing providers on higher rungs are dropped
Unnameable higher rungs must drop safely with visible too-big failure finding rather than silent provider crossing or crashes
